instance_description:
Setting: In 2026, a neighborhood recreational archery club uses a municipal indoor range and seasonal outdoor field for practice, leagues, equipment upkeep, and small weekend shoots.
Scope: Covers one member’s recurring archery life: practice planning, scoring habits, gear maintenance, shared equipment coordination, league entries, tournament preparation, safety reminders, and hobby budgeting.
Resources: Empty SQLite tables can hold reusable profile, equipment, and event records; blank text files support later notes, packets, and inventories; one personal wallet starts at zero.
Exclusions: Excludes formal coaching courses, professional competition, unrelated social outings, medical advice, facility operations outside club participation, and scenario-specific facts.
personal_description:
Identity: Cassian Reed Montoya is a recreational recurve archer in Portland, Oregon, active throughout 2026 with the nonprofit Hawthorne Bowmen club.
Responsibilities: He practices weekly, maintains his own bow kit, helps track loaner equipment condition, signs up for local shoots, and prepares personal scoring and packing notes.
Authority: Cassian may manage his own hobby records, payments, registrations, reminders, and club-facing volunteer notes, but he does not control official club finances or facility scheduling.
Restrictions: He avoids handling minors’ personal data, changing official tournament rules, representing himself as a certified coach, or using records for non-archery matters.
